description: Pattern: Sun-Drenched Scale Chestguard Item Level 75 Requires Leatherworking (365) Use: Teaches you how to craft Sun-Drenched Scale Chestguard. Sell Price: 2 Sun-Drenched Scale Chestguard Item Level 159 Binds when picked up Chest Mail 1110 Armor +48 Stamina +41 Intellect Red Socket Red Socket Red Socket Socket Bonus: 2 mana per 5 sec. Durability 140 / 140 Requires Level 70 Requires Leatherworking (350) Equip: Improves spell haste rating by 40. Sell Price: 9 51 6 Requires Heavy Knothide Leather (40), Nether Dragonscales (24), Primal Might (6), Primal Nether (6)
